c74object.name: ossia.v8connector
c74object.digest: Declare ossia parameters from a script
c74object.description: Create a node of the ossia namespace, like ossia.model, whose parameters are declared by messages instead of ossia.parameter objects. A v8 or v8ui script adds, removes and sets the parameters, and receives the values changed by any other source on the left outlet. The node registers under the ossia.model, ossia.device or ossia.client found in the patcher hierarchy, or under the global device.

inlet.name: Message input
inlet.description: add, remove, clear and set messages

outlet.name: Values
outlet.description: A message per changed parameter, the relative address followed by the value. Values set through this instance do not come back here.

outlet.name: Info outlet
outlet.description: address, add, remove, clear and error messages

objarg.name: Name
objarg.digest: Name of the node in the ossia namespace
objarg.description: ossia.v8connector requires a node name. The declared parameters are created under this node. When several nodes have the same name, instances (name.1, name.2, etc...) are created, as for ossia.model.

method.name: add
method.digest: Create a parameter under the node
method.description: The message add followed by a relative address and attributes creates a parameter, with the same attribute names as ossia.parameter: @type, @min, @max, @range, @unit, @default, @clip, @mode, @description, @tags, @priority, @rate, @critical, @invisible, @repetitions, @enable, @recall_safe. @type is required. A numeric type (float, int, vec2f, vec3f, vec4f) requires @min and @max, or @range: the declaration is refused otherwise, and an error is reported on the right outlet.

method.name: remove
method.description: The message remove followed by a relative address removes the parameter declared by this instance at that address.

method.name: clear
method.digest: Remove every parameter of this instance
method.description: The message clear removes every parameter declared by this instance. The node itself stays.

method.name: set
method.digest: Set the value of a parameter
method.description: The message set followed by a relative address and a value pushes the value to the parameter, clipped to its range according to @clip. The value is sent to the network and to every other ossia object that listens to this address, but does not come back on the left outlet of this instance.

method.name: address
method.description: The message address followed by a symbol sets the name of the node and registers it again with its parameters.

method.name: namespace
method.digest: Output list of all parameters and their current values
method.description: The namespace message outputs on the right outlet the list of all parameters registered under this node, and their current values

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: The description attribute allows to set a description to the node

attribute.name: invisible
attribute.description: The invisible attribute allows to hide the node from remote clients

attribute.name: priority
attribute.description: The priority attribute allows to order how several values of a same hierarchical level can be recalled

attribute.name: recall_safe
attribute.digest: Enable or disable value update when recalling preset
attribute.description: The recall_safe attribute (default: off) allows to prevent value update when recalling a preset.

attribute.name: tags
attribute.description: The tags attribute allows to associate a variable number of tags for this node.

attribute.name: trim_address
attribute.digest: Output absolute or relative address path
attribute.description: The trim_address attribute sets whether the address is output as a relative or absolute path
